name: Hapa Second Brain App Kanban
summary: App-specific Hapa protocol board for Hapa Second Brain. Role: Local-first knowledge database, retrieval memory, and operator UI.

columns.label: Backlog
columns.intent: Known work not yet ready for an agent.

columns.label: Ready
columns.intent: Scoped work with enough context to start.

columns.label: Blocked
columns.intent: Work that needs a decision, dependency, or external state change.

columns.label: Review
columns.intent: Ready for Overwatch/user review and integration check.

actors.label: QuestKeeper
actors.role: Consolidated audit and board coverage agent.

actors.label: Green
actors.role: UI, operator workflow, QA, demo state.

actors.label: Human
actors.role: Project owner, reviewer, and priority authority.

sourceTruthHierarchy: Second Brain README, AGENTS.md, docs, and wiki_articles
protocol.recordRule: Every app build action, protocol audit, blocker, handoff, verification, and review note is appended as an event. The board is derived from the event log.
protocol.safeActionPolicy: This board records coordination and protocol state. Do not mutate source memories, credentials, source exports, generated media, or node stores without explicit human authorization.
